home-hero.alt: A wooden table with handmade natural products: amber jars of cream, lavender-topped soap bars, a lit candle in a glass jar, dropper bottles, eucalyptus, rosemary and chamomile.

soap-hero.alt: A loaf of cold process soap with pink and green swirls being cut into bars on a wooden board, with a soap cutter, oats and dried calendula petals.

candles-hero.alt: Pouring melted wax into a glass jar on a kitchen table, surrounded by dessert-style candles: a cupcake candle, a strawberry sponge cake candle, dried orange slices and cinnamon sticks.
